pkgmetadata.longdescription: Soulbrandt runs your own copy of Demon's Souls for the PS3 natively on a PC. Its setup lifts the game's PowerPC and SPU code to C and C++ with ps3recomp, and compiles it with clang into a module that the program loads; a runtime written for the game stands in for the PS3's system libraries, and its graphics run on Vulkan (or Direct3D 12 through vkd3d). No game files are included.
